evidence.basis: Every reviewed frame is an excerpt from 喜羊羊与灰太狼 and carries a visible Bilibili uploader watermark in addition to the channel overlay.
The four ASR segments capture only fragments of cartoon dialogue and omit most of the 30.19-second scene.
The only channel-level framing is the title's wish not to be a 沸羊羊, a meme/theme already represented by formal and current-batch sources.

boundary: Zero weight. Treat the animation and its dialogue as third-party copyrighted material, not as Mikey testimony, experience or a verified relationship model. The upload title alone does not establish a detailed Mikey-authored argument.
